  "semantic_type": "flow",
  "unit": "USD",
  "additive_over_entities": true,
  "additive_over_time": true,
  "time_rollup": "reported_fy_value",
  "valid_methods": ["sum_across_entities", "sum_over_time", "pct_change"],
  "period_basis": "mixed",
  "derivation": "Revenue as reported in SEC XBRL filings (10-Q and 10-K). The XBRL concept is RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax for DRI and Revenues for CMG, WING and YUM. Rows cover discrete quarters (Q), cumulative year-to-date periods (YTD6, YTD9) and full fiscal years (FY). YTD and FY rows overlap the quarterly rows, so only rows with the same period_basis should be summed or compared, and annual figures should use the reported FY row.",
  "calendar": "fiscal",
  "seasonal_adjustment": null,
  "annualized": false,
  "entity_grain": "ticker",
  "hierarchy": null,
  "comparability": "by_definition_id",
  "lineage": {
    "source": "SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts API",
    "url_template": "https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK{cik}.json",
    "retrieved_on": "2026-10-24"
  },
  "description": "Reported revenue in USD for each company and reporting period, taken from SEC XBRL company facts. It is a flow measure. Periods may be a single quarter, year-to-date (6 or 9 months) or a full fiscal year. The XBRL concept name differs by company, so compare across companies by concept."
